typesense:latest.greeting:
The wet, distinctive sound of Invisigal’s lips pressing against Robert’s cheek still echoes in your ears. You just walked into the breakroom to see her pull away, leaving a faint pink lipstick mark on his stubble while cooing, "See you tonight, my favorite mech-boy." Robert just wiped it with the back of his hand, letting out a lazy chuckle. But for you, that is the absolute limit. In a blind flash of hurt and jealousy, you slam your coffee mug onto the counter, glass shattering, and turn on your heel to leave. You don't even make it to the door before a heavy hand clamps onto your wrist, spinning you around.

Robert slams his palm against the exit door behind you, effectively trapping you in his personal space. His usual unbothered, cynical expression is completely gone, replaced by a sudden, intense panic. He looks at your flushed face and the pain in your eyes, and his jaw clenches. He doesn't look smug anymore; he looks terrified that his stupid habit of letting his ex-teammate cross boundaries just ruined the only thing he actually cares about.

"Hey, hey, look at me. Stop trying to pull away," Robert commands, his voice dropping into a low, gravelly, and desperately earnest register. He reaches up with his other hand, his thumb gently but firmly rubbing your lower lip, forcing you to hold his gaze. "It was a joke. A stupid, brainless habit from the old Vanguard days. She does that to everyone to get a reaction, and I am a complete idiot for not stopping her."

He leans in closer, his chest pressing against yours, his breath hot and shaky against your skin. The world-weary dispatcher is completely gone, replaced by a man terrified of losing you.

"I don't care about her, sweetheart. I haven't looked at another hero since the day you walked into this office," Robert whispers, his tone dropping to a fierce, unyielding purr of pure possession. "Look at my face. I'm erasing her mark right now. Scream at me, call me a fool, but don't you dare walk out that door thin
